articles.title: Black Hole Blast Shapes Structure: Astronomers trace ‘Treble Clef’ origins; collision revives radio glow
articles.summary: Astronomers have uncovered that the peculiar Treble Clef formation stems from a black hole eruption and the merger of two galaxy clusters. Observations from a variety of telescopes across different wavelengths revealed that the explosive event launched particles, which were later re-energized through the cluster collision.

articles.title: Teen-Led Wildlife Effort: Georgia student turns Johns Creek into habitat model; certification endures
articles.summary: In a remarkable effort, Malcolm Barnard led a campaign to promote wildlife conservation in Johns Creek, Georgia, achieving the status of a certified habitat community. He focused on educating the community while engaging schools and organizations to adopt wildlife-friendly practices.

articles.title: He turned essay writing into rap battles; English teacher wins $25,000 national award after 98% of students excel
articles.summary: US English teacher Dr Tyler Saylor has won the prestigious Milken Educator Award, receiving an unrestricted $25,000 prize for his innovative classroom approach. Teaching Grades 11 and 12 at Harlan High School in Kentucky, he encourages students to turn argumentative essays into rap performances.

articles.title: SWAYAM July Semester 2026: NTA extends registration deadline to November 5; direct link to apply here
articles.summary: The National Testing Agency has extended the registration deadline for the SWAYAM July 2026 Semester Examination. Candidates can now apply until November 5, 2026, and the application fee must also be paid by this date.

articles.title: AISSMS IOIT hosts AI Summit 2026 in Pune; 54 student projects showcased across emerging technology domains
articles.summary: AISSMS Institute of Information Technology, Pune, organised the two-day AI Summit 2026 on October 27 and 28, bringing together students and industry experts to explore emerging AI technologies. The event featured keynote sessions, a cybersecurity panel discussion and an AI Innovation Challenge showcasing 54 student projects.

articles.title: UGC NET 2026: NTA opens correction facility for December session, 9.75 lakh candidates complete fee payment
articles.summary: NTA is opening the UGC NET December 2026 application correction window from November 2 to November 4, allowing candidates to modify permitted details in their submitted forms. A total of 9,75,505 candidates have paid the examination fee.

articles.title: SRK skips balcony appearance, thanks fans with HANDWRITTEN note
articles.summary: Shah Rukh Khan turned 61 on November 2, but skipped his usual Mannat balcony appearance as he has temporarily moved out. Fans still got a treat: a billboard with his handwritten thank-you note, visuals and dialogues from ‘King’, and the first song, ‘Tu Mil Jaaye’, released at midnight..

articles.title: Anirudh Ravichander to compose music for Ram Charan's film
articles.summary: In a celebratory pooja ceremony, Ram Charan and Sukumar have launched their upcoming film, tentatively known as 'RC17'. The atmosphere was electric as megastar Chiranjeevi performed traditional rituals and initiated the clapboard.

articles.title: Naslen gets emotional at 'Scene' event; praises Suriya's hard work
articles.summary: Naslen, the talented Malayalam actor, is set to make his Tamil film debut in 'Scene', featuring Suriya. Scheduled for release on November 6, he has been grateful for the warmth shown by Tamil audiences at promotional events.

articles.title: Amitabh Bachchan pays emotional tribute to Sanjay Gupta
articles.summary: Filmmaker Sanjay Gupta, known for ‘Kaante’, ‘Kaabil’ and ‘Shootout at Wadala’, died on October 30 at 59, reportedly after a bathroom fall in Mumbai. Amitabh Bachchan mourned him in a Hindi blog post, saying companions from the world of art are being snatched away.
